title: 1. What is a CTF?
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L22: CTF Skills & Exam 3 Prep: 1. What is a CTF?.

blocks.text: Capture The Flag (CTF) — a cybersecurity competition where players solve puzzles to recover hidden "flags" (text strings, e.g., flag{hello_world}).

rows: Independent challenges by category, point values; solve as many as possible in time window
Each team runs a vulnerable service; attack others while defending your own
Compete to control a single shared system

items: Web — exploit web applications (XSS, SQLi, IDOR, auth bypass, SSRF)
Pwn / Binary Exploitation — buffer overflow, format string, ROP
Crypto — break or implement cryptographic schemes
Forensics — analyze disk/memory/pcap dumps to find hidden data
Reverse Engineering (Rev) — reverse a binary to understand or bypass it
OSINT — open-source intelligence (reverse image search, social media, WHOIS)

blocks.text: Typically flag{...} or CTF{...} — the wrapper signals you've found the answer. Real flags hide the secret string inside the braces.
